| Voters sent important messages in this election: bring down costs and end the war
---
Derek, on December 11, government funding runs out, and Congress will have to negotiate a new budget. That gives us our first chance to act on what voters demanded at the ballot box on November 3. And one of their chief concerns: **They want an end to the war in Iran.** We can use the budget process to try and cut off funding for this war and press the administration to bring it to a conclusion. Congress _never_ authorized this war, and the American people _never_ asked for it. The administration’s justifications keep shifting, and the main thing the war has done is raise costs for the American people, even as it has emboldened Iran, which now has more say over the Strait of Hormuz than it did before the war began. The war is costing families at home. It has driven up what we pay for gas, diesel, and fertilizer. By ending this illegal war, we can bring down the everyday costs voters told us about at the ballot box. **[Derek, will you add your name to stand with me in calling for an immediate end to funding for the Iran war?](https://act.adamschiff.com/signup/aschiff_email_112326_endthewar/?t=9&refcode=aschiff_email_112326_endthewar&akid=10954%2E5257348%2EQgrUnu)** | | [ADD YOUR NAME→](https://act.adamschiff.com/signup/aschiff_email_112326_endthewar/?t=10&refcode=aschiff_email_112326_endthewar&akid=10954%2E5257348%2EQgrUnu)

body:

#
| | | | Hey, Peter – just following up on the invite we sent the other day to sign our card congratulating SENATOR-ELECT Roy Cooper before we present it to him over the holiday weekend!
---
**Since we’re still a few names short of our 25,000-signature goal, we decided to push back the deadline until 11:59 p.m. tonight.**
So if you haven’t had the chance to add yours, here’s that link again: [**_https:/ /act.roycooper.com/sign-the-card_**](https://act.roycooper.com/survey/sign-the-card-2026-email/?email=&zip=&amounts=5,25,50,100,250&ask=5&source=email_su_pros_jtk1640&t=5&akid=5366%2E124072%2EfAL6L7)
Roy will be overjoyed to count you among the folks rooting for him as he carries on the fight to make stuff cost less when he gets to Washington DC.
Thanks again, and happy early Thanksgiving!
Team Cooper
\---------- Forwarded message ----------
From: **Team Cooper**
Date: Friday, Nov 13, 2026
Subject: Sign the card for SENATOR-ELECT Roy Cooper 🎉
| |
| | | [](https://act.roycooper.com/survey/sign-the-card-2026-email/?email=&zip=&amounts=5,25,50,100,250&ask=5&source=email_su_pros_jtk1640&t=6&akid=5366%2E124072%2EfAL6L7) | We did it, Peter! 🎉
---
Democrats pulled off some historic upsets in this year’s midterm elections, held crucial battleground seats and took back the Senate majority. Soon, Roy Cooper will be sworn in as North Carolina’s next U.S. Senator – the first Democratic Senator elected from our state in nearly two decades.
Roy is ready to fix what’s broken in Washington DC. He’s ready to _make stuff cost less_ and be a champion for working families across the country. He won’t stop fighting for us, and we want to show him this team has his back.
**That’s why we’re putting together a congratulations card for the Senator-elect, and we’re counting on 25,000 folks to sign it today – including you, Peter.**
[**_Will you sign the card congratulating Roy and wish him well before he heads to Washington DC? We know he’ll appreciate it, and we can’t wait to show him all of the people cheering him on!_**](https://act.roycooper.com/survey/sign-the-card-2026-email/?email=&zip=&amounts=5,25,50,100,250&ask=5&source=email_su_pros_jtk1640&t=7&akid=5366%2E124072%2EfAL6L7)

---
This moment wouldn’t have been possible without this team. Thank you so much.

Team Cooper
| |
* * *
[](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_su_pros_jtk1640&t=1&akid=5366%2E124072%2EfAL6L7)
Roy Cooper was born and raised in North Carolina, and he’s spent his life in public service fighting to improve the lives of ordinary people. He’s a former state legislator, Attorney General and Governor – and come January 2027, he will serve as North Carolina’s next U.S. Senator.

After flipping this crucial seat to Democrats for the first time in nearly 20 years, Roy is ready to roll up his sleeves and get to work to stop the chaos in Washington DC, and most importantly, make real progress for working families.

Roy will need grassroots supporters like you with him every step of the way. **So if you can, make a donation to ensure Roy can keep up the fight in the U.S. Senate.**

Friend, over the past year, the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) and Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) have unleashed unprecedented violence across American neighborhoods.
Armed agents have conducted indiscriminate sweeps near schools and playgrounds, detained hundreds of U.S. citizens without cause, and deployed military-style tactics against ordinary people. DHS and ICE have been responsible for operations resulting in 30 people being shot, multiple fatalities, the indiscriminate use of chemical agents on unarmed people, and countless other human rights violations.
**This is not lawful enforcement. It is the weaponization of federal power against citizens and noncitizens alike.**
As Ranking Member of the Senate Permanent Subcommittee on Investigations, I have led a formal inquiry into these abuses. For well over a year, I have written to DHS leadership more than a dozen times demanding answers, yet they have failed to provide a single response.
Instead of cooperating with Congress, DHS has weakened hiring standards, slashed training programs, and avoided our oversight while innocent people get hurt or killed.**That is why I recently issued 25 sweeping demands to Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin to turn over every single record regarding shootings, chemical agent deployments, arrest quotas, and the unlawful detention of U.S. citizens.**
No government agency is above the law, and no administration has the right to terrorize our communities in secret.
**[_That’s why I want to hear from you directly as we prepare to hold these officials accountable. **DNC Announces Framework for the 2028 Democratic Presidential Primary Debates**
---
| |

| | _DNC announces debate framework earlier than ever as Democrats prepare to take back the White House in 2028

Announcement includes new Fair Campaign Practices Pledge to limit the role of dark money in the 2028 Democratic primary _
Washington, D.C. — Today, the DNC announced the initial framework for the 2028 Democratic presidential primary debates process, as well as the leadership team who will oversee the effort. The DNC’s core objective for the 2028 primary debates is to ensure the process is transparent, fair, and rigorous, so that the eventual Democratic Party nominee emerges stronger and ready to take back the White House.

The DNC’s 2028 Debate Planning Committee will be led by DNC Senior Advisor for Debates Minyon Moore and DNC Executive Director Roger Lau. The committee also includes former advisors and staff from the 2020 presidential campaigns of President Biden and Senators Sanders, Warren, and Klobuchar – as well as alumni from the campaigns of Barack Obama, Hillary Clinton, and Kamala Harris. The committee has held a number of meetings in recent months with top staff from prior primary cycles and other stakeholders who have knowledge of and experience with the debate process to inform planning efforts.

_**Statement from DNC Chair Ken Martin:**_ “Democrats are on offense after our historic victories in the midterms, and the DNC is keeping our foot on the gas as we head into the 2028 cycle. The fair and transparent process and experienced leadership team we’re announcing today will keep our party united, strengthen our eventual nominee, and put Democrats in position to take back the White House.”
_**Statement from 2028 Senior Advisor for Debates Minyon Moore:**_ “I’m honored to be guiding the team that will run the 2028 Democratic Presidential Primary Debate process. I’m committed to ensuring our debate process is not only fair and transparent, but that it also sets our nominee up for success in the general election.”
**Key Details on 2028 Debate Process:**
* The DNC is announcing 12 presidential primary debates over the course of the 2028 cycle, with five debates in 2027 and seven in 2028. All early-state debates will be held in 2028.
* The first two debates will occur in June and July 2027. The DNC plans to hold its final debate in March 2028, but reserves the right to adjust the schedule as necessary.
* The DNC will announce specific dates, locations, media partners and more regarding the first two debates in January 2027.
* In order to provide our candidates with a platform to make their case to voters, the DNC will seek to maximize the viewership of the debates, including by incorporating creators and influencers into the debate process.
* Candidates may participate in town halls, forums, or other events in which one candidate appears on stage at a time. However, they may not participate in events in which two or more candidates share the stage, whether virtually or in-person, and answer questions – which would constitute an unsanctioned debate. Candidates who participate in unsanctioned debates will not be eligible for future DNC debates.
* Given the fluid nature of the presidential nominating process, the DNC will continuously assess the state of the race and make adjustments to this process as appropriate, and always transparently.
* In order to accommodate a potentially large field of candidates, early debates may occur over two consecutive nights.
* In the event that the qualifying field of candidates requires these debates to be held over two nights, the lineup for each night will be determined at random – in a manner that will ensure parity across both nights – with qualifying candidates assigned one night per debate.
* The DNC will cap the number of participants at 20 across two nights, in the event that the qualifying field of candidates exceeds that amount.

**Debate Qualification Information:**
* Similar to the 2020 debate process, candidates will qualify for the debates by meeting criteria that include polling and other objective measures that reflect a candidate’s support, such as grassroots fundraising – in addition to meeting the standard filing and constitutional requirements to run for President of the United States.
* The specific criteria for the first two debates will be announced in January 2027.
* Candidates will also be required to abide by DNC rules to ensure a fair process, including:
* Fair Campaign Practices Pledge – Candidates will be required to sign and follow the DNC’s Fair Campaign Practices Pledge committing to denounce dark money spending in our primary in order to qualify for debate participation. Given the importance of party committee neutrality during the presidential nominating process, candidates will also pledge not to enter into joint fundraising agreements with any Democratic Party committee or authorize any coordinated party spending during the primary.
* More information about the pledge can be found on the DNC’s 2028 web page [here](https://us.list-manage.com/RtN9kB2LCnQ?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e).
* Delegate Selection Rules – Candidates will be required to follow the [DNC-passed Delegate Selection Rules](https://us.list-manage.com/PfCZ24crkaU?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e), including Rule 21, which prohibits participation in or campaigning for unsanctioned contests during the early window and requires candidates to denounce any efforts to campaign on their behalf in unsanctioned contests in order to qualify for debate participation. More information on the requirements within Rule 21 can be found [here](https://us.list-manage.com/7IJf73wmtgA?e=d6c5c7d7ec&c2id=d01ae369e8fbc8d507a43d27c2d1769e).

I've always believed that winning elections is about more than putting a Democrat in office. **It's about building the power to make a real difference in people's lives.** And this November, that's exactly what we did. Across the country, Democratic women made history, flipped seats, and helped deliver a blue wave that will change the direction of our country. Here in Michigan, we elected Jocelyn Benson as our next governor and Winnie Brinks as our next lieutenant governor. We reelected Chief Justice Megan Cavanagh to our state Supreme Court. And we elected more than a dozen EMILYs List-endorsed women to the state legislature, helping Democrats take back full control of our state government. **I'm proud of what we accomplished. And I'm especially proud that my friends at EMILYs List helped make so many of these victories possible.** But here's what I know after eight years as governor: Winning an election is just the beginning. **[That's why I'm asking you to make a donation to EMILYs List today. They're already laying the groundwork for the next generation of Democratic pro-choice women to run, win, and lead — and they need our support.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/143922537/661831182/1325061702?refcode=WUEFEW91_20261123_WhitmerNov_PL_v1s1&sourceid=1060703&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNRUwvMS84NzA2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzNTQ3NGM1NC01N2U3LWYxMTEtOTFmMy0wMDBkM2E1MzM5NzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=LTwvjxsohL4rBrUK4fmxTMKwr6_7g4yGjaWUB1C8Ewo=)** | [DONATE NOW](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/143922538/661831210/1325061702?refcode=WUEFEW91_20261123_WhitmerNov_PL_v1s1&sourceid=1060703&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNRUwvMS84NzA2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzNTQ3NGM1NC01N2U3LWYxMTEtOTFmMy0wMDBkM2E1MzM5NzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=LTwvjxsohL4rBrUK4fmxTMKwr6_7g4yGjaWUB1C8Ewo=)

For more than 40 years, EMILYs List has understood something that too many people in politics overlook: If we want more women in positions of power, we have to invest in them long before Election Day.
That means recruiting talented women to run for office. Giving them the training and resources to build winning campaigns. And standing beside them when the going gets tough.
We saw what that commitment made possible in Michigan this year. And across the country, EMILYs List women helped Democrats flip the U.S. House, take back the Senate, and win critical races at every level of government.
Now, we have an opportunity to build on that momentum.
Because the fight for reproductive freedom isn't over. The work of lowering costs for working families isn't over. And our responsibility to protect the progress we've made certainly isn't over.
**The next generation of women leaders is out there right now. And the investments we make today will help determine whether they're ready to win in 2027, 2028, and beyond.**
Peter, I'm proud to be an EMILYs List woman. I've seen firsthand what this organization can accomplish when supporters like you step up.

It's about building the power to make a real difference in people's lives. And this November, that's exactly what we did. Across the country, Democratic women made history, flipped seats, and helped deliver a blue wave that will change the direction of our country. Here in Michigan, we elected Jocelyn Benson as our next governor and Winnie Brinks as our next lieutenant governor. We reelected Chief Justice Megan Cavanagh to our state Supreme Court. And we elected more than a dozen EMILYs List-endorsed women to the state legislature, helping Democrats take back full control of our state government. I'm proud of what we accomplished. And I'm especially proud that my friends at EMILYs List helped make so many of these victories possible. But here's what I know after eight years as governor: Winning an election is just the beginning. = | = For more than 40 years, EMILYs List has understood something that too many people in politics overlook: If we want more women in positions of power, we have to invest in them long before Election Day. That means recruiting talented women to run for office. Giving them the training and resources to build winning campaigns. And standing beside them when the going gets tough. We saw what that commitment made possible in Michigan this year. And across the country, EMILYs List women helped Democrats flip the U.S. House, take back the Senate, and win critical races at every level of government. Now, we have an opportunity to build on that momentum. Because the fight for reproductive freedom isn't over. The work of lowering costs for working families isn't over. subject: This wasn’t my intent

body:
I definitely didn’t intend to end up in court against the Secretary of Defense after spending 25 years in the Navy and NASA.
#

Friend --
It’s hard to tell what you’re getting yourself into at the start of something. Gabby and I knew things were going to change when I ran for Senate, and we know more than most how public service can change your life.
We didn’t expect things to go like this, though. Getting attacked by the richest guy on Earth wasn’t on my to-do list, and neither was having the President of the United States call for my arrest and execution. And I definitely didn’t intend to end up in court against the Secretary of Defense after spending 25 years in the Navy and NASA.
But when Donald Trump and Pete Hegseth came after me, they came after the free speech rights of millions of retired veterans, too. They were trying to intimidate people into silence, to stop them from speaking out. After all those years in service, I couldn’t let that stand.
It was a over a year ago that all of this started, when Trump tried to brand me a traitor, and it isn’t over yet. We’ve got a decision in this case coming. We don’t know when, and we’ll find out when everyone else does.
But I do know the only reason we’ve made it this far is because of this team. You’ve been with me for a long time, and you haven’t backed down. That means a lot to me, really.
I’ve always been willing to fight for our democracy, but it gives me a lot of hope to know that I’m not in this alone.
[**And as we wait for that decision, I’m hoping I can count on you one more time. Will you make a donation to my campaign and help raise the resources we'll need to fight back against whatever Trump and Hegseth throw at us?**](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-nov26.3Xma5G&refcode=em261123-1-MS&t=1&akid=6833%2E6688874%2E04duWZ)

Three weeks ago, the American people went to the ballot box and cried out for accountability. Accountability for the corruption, the cruelty, and the sheer stupidity running rampant in Donald Trump's Washington.
So how has the President of the United States responded?
He spent the last couple of days abusing his power to get his billionaire buddy Jensen Huang reinstated as CEO of NVIDIA earlier today. This comes after it was revealed that Huang was very likely cheating on his wife with a Chinese spy, endangering our national security secrets, and sleeping with at least two subordinates to top it all off.
Reinstalling this man is the response. Let that sink in.
The entire power of this federal government now exists to protect a small handful of corrupt, well-connected billionaires who do not give a damn about you or me. They believe they can get away with anything. They believe the only things that matter are profit share and shareholder value. Donald Trump and the Republican Party simply do not understand why they lost.
You cannot tell me there isn't another fucking person on this planet who could run NVIDIA without cheating on their spouse with a Chinese spy, and endangering Americans in the process. I don't believe it. They're too arrogant to bother. Instead, they're shoving it in our faces: there will never be accountability for this class of people.
I guarantee you that if you got caught at work cheating on your spouse with a Chinese spy and endangering your company's secrets, you would lose your job. I would lose my job. My clients would never want to work with me again. My father was a 34-year veteran of the FBI. If he'd done even a fraction of the stupid things that Trump, Huang, Hegseth, Patel, and Lutnick do every day, he'd have been gone in a heartbeat.
But not these people. They're too rich. Too powerful. Too connected to fail.
Remember what Trump said on the Access Hollywood tape? When you're a star, they let you do it. Well, when you're a billionaire, or friends with one, they let you do it.
And we pay the price. More likely than not, Americans are less safe today. We're less likely to win the AI race with China that Republicans keep screaming about. The same race they use to justify building data centers in working class neighborhoods, and not their own. China may now have access to these chips, and possibly intelligence gleaned from this relationship. There will be no accountability for any of it.
* * *
#### _**[Accountability shouldn't be a privilege reserved for people who can't afford to escape it.](https://substack.com/redirect/f9928e8e-05bf-488d-ba7b-a22be9f8d503?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ At Endless Urgency, we're committed to examining the people and institutions wielding enormous power over our lives, regardless of how wealthy or well-connected they are. Marco Rubio and the State Department warned Trump about this. Senate Republicans warned NVIDIA and Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick for months. Now, in my opinion, the entire federal government is covering it up. Partly to protect the wealthy shareholders panicking over NVIDIA's stock drop, and partly to protect a President and a Commerce Secretary who are both wrapped up in this scandal.
Over the weekend we learned that Lutnick likely only kept his job because Trump took a $25 million bribe from him, dressed up as a donation to Trump's presidential library, which is basically a slush fund for the Trump family. Trump was already sick of Lutnick. Lutnick bet against the U.S. economy with his son on tariff rebates. He lied about his relationship with Jeffrey Epstein. None of it mattered. A massive bribe later, he's still in the cabinet, knee-deep in a scandal about China getting its hands on our AI chips.
They got shellacked in the midterms, and they've learned absolutely nothing. That's why Stephen Miller is now chief of staff and Susie Wiles, the only professional in the goddamn White House, is out. That's why Pete Hegseth is still running an illegal war in Iran that's driving up your costs. Trump knows his days are numbered, and he just doesn't give a shit.
And why would he? Nothing in his life has ever taught him he'd be held accountable. Not when he refused to rent his slumlord apartments to Black families in the '70s. Not when he was caught sexually harassing women, potentially including underage girls. Not when he tried to overturn an election and incited a riot at the Capitol on January 6th, killing multiple police officers.
So why would he be held accountable for this? He's Donald Trump. He's better than you. He's above the law. They all are.
We'll know the truth one day about what happened with Jensen Huang, NVIDIA, and Trump. But deep down, I think we already know.
Nothing gets better for the 80% of Americans who are struggling until we break these concentrations of wealth and power. The Epstein class, the billionaire class, the Big Tech class, the Trump class. That means ethics reform, campaign finance reform, and a Department of Justice that actually holds these people accountable again. For the first time in a long time, I believe it's achievable, because Americans finally see how this corruption makes their own lives worse. Once we do that, raising wages, protecting jobs from AI, and fixing healthcare all get a hell of a lot easier.
They got away with another one, and they're counting on you to forget about it over Thanksgiving. They're counting on you to eat turkey, watch football, and move on. I'm going to do the first two gleefully with my family this weekend. But I'm not going to forget this one, and I'm sure as hell not going to forgive it.
With urgency,
--Mike

We're less likely to win the AI race with China that Republicans keep screaming about. The same race they use to justify building data centers in working class neighborhoods, and not their own. China may now have access to these chips, and possibly intelligence gleaned from this relationship. There will be no accountability for any of it. Already a paid subscriber? Like, share, and join the conversation. Your engagement helps us reach more people and grow this community. Marco Rubio and the State Department warned Trump about this. Senate Republicans warned NVIDIA and Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick for months. Now, in my opinion, the entire federal government is covering it up. Partly to protect the wealthy shareholders panicking over NVIDIA's stock drop, and partly to protect a President and a Commerce Secretary who are both wrapped up in this scandal. Over the weekend we learned that Lutnick likely only kept his job because Trump took a $25 million bribe from him, dressed up as a donation to Trump's presidential library, which is basically a slush fund for the Trump family. Trump was already sick of Lutnick. Lutnick bet against the U.S. economy with his son on tariff rebates. He lied about his relationship with Jeffrey Epstein. None of it mattered. A massive bribe later, he's still in the cabinet, knee-deep in a scandal about China getting its hands on our AI chips. They got shellacked in the midterms, and they've learned absolutely nothing. That's why Stephen Miller is now chief of staff and Susie Wiles, the only professional in the goddamn White House, is out. That's why Pete Hegseth is still running an illegal war in Iran that's driving up your costs. Trump knows his days are numbered, and he just doesn't give a shit. And why would he? Nothing in his life has ever taught him he'd be held accountable. Not when he refused to rent his slumlord apartments to Black families in the '70s. Not when he was caught sexually harassing women, potentially including underage girls. Not when he tried to overturn an election and incited a riot at the Capitol on January 6th, killing multiple police officers. So why would he be held accountable for this? He's Donald Trump. He's better than you. He's above the law. They all are. We'll know the truth one day about what happened with Jensen Huang, NVIDIA, and Trump. But deep down, I think we already know. Nothing gets better for the 80% of Americans who are struggling until we break these concentrations of wealth and power. The Epstein class, the billionaire class, the Big Tech class, the Trump class. That means ethics reform, campaign finance reform, and a Department of Justice that actually holds these people accountable again. For the first time in a long time, I believe it's achievable, because Americans finally see how this corruption makes their own lives worse. Once we do that, raising wages, protecting jobs from AI, and fixing healthcare all get a hell of a lot easier. They got away with another one, and they're counting on you to forget about it over Thanksgiving. They're counting on you to eat turkey, watch football, and move on. I'm going to do the first two gleefully with my family this weekend. But I'm not going to forget this one, and I'm sure as hell not going to forgive it. With urgency, --Mike Already a paid subscriber? You can still make a difference. Like, share, and join the conversation in the comments. Every bit of engagement helps us reach more people, grow this community, and keep the momentum going. name: Office of U.S. Senator Angela Alsobrooks
subject: Senator Alsobrooks Newsletter -- November 23, 2026
body:
|

---
Dear Friends and Neighbors, I would like to start by wishing you and your family a happy Thanksgiving. And as we gather around our tables this holiday season, I just want to say thank you for your passion, your commitment, your advocacy, and for loving our great state and the Marylanders who live here. This season, I am especially grateful for the people who give so much of themselves to others: the volunteers at our food banks and pantries, the nurses and first responders working through the holiday, our service members who are spending Thanksgiving far from home, and those who have lost loved ones. I am keeping in my prayers the families who will have an empty seat at the table this year. I also know that for many Marylanders, putting a holiday meal on the table has never been harder. But I can commit to you that I will keep working every day to lower costs for Maryland families, from groceries and housing to health care, so that every family can gather around a full table. From my family to yours, I wish you a happy and peaceful Thanksgiving. When the 120th Congress convenes in January, the United States Senate will have a Democratic majority. For nearly two years, I have watched this Administration make life harder for Maryland families, and I have watched too many of my colleagues in Congress look the other way. That will soon change. A majority is not a trophy. It is a responsibility, a responsibility I will take seriously. We will hold accountable those who have made life harder for Maryland families. That means real oversight: hearings built to get answers and make progress, not to play to the cameras. The American people deserve to know where their money went, who profited, and why. We will work to restore health care to the Marylanders who lost it through no fault of their own. People who worked hard, paid their bills, and followed the rules had their coverage stripped away by choices made in Washington. We will fight to give it back. We will fight to restore Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) benefits for the tens of thousands of Marylanders who have had them taken away. No child in our state should go to school hungry, and no senior should have to choose between groceries and medication. We will bring down costs. That includes ending these tariffs, which have acted as a tax on every family at the grocery store, at the gas pump, and when buying essentials. We will work to end this war in Iran. I have voted 13 times to end this war, and it's time to bring our service members home and to stop spending billions of taxpayer dollars on a conflict with no clear end. _Holding This Administration Accountable _ A Democratic majority means oversight with real teeth. But I haven't waited for January to start asking hard questions. From the beginning, I have been dogged about the chaos, cost, and corruption that has followed Robert F. Kennedy Jr. into the Department of Health and Human Services. Mass layoffs gutted the agencies where so many Marylanders proudly serve. Critical research on cancer and Alzheimer's was canceled. And the corruption keeps coming to light. This is not abstract. Just this month, the Pan American Health Organization revoked the United States' measles elimination status as measles surges across our nation, including here in Maryland. Public health officials worked tirelessly for decades to achieve measles elimination status in the United States--and in less than two years at the helm, RFK Jr. rolled back over a quarter century of progress. An utter disgrace. Our nation was once the envy around the world, the crown jewel of medical advancement, research, and discovery. Now our health is held hostage by the lies of a conspiracy theorist. Countless American lives will continue to be lost because of RFK Jr.'s disastrous tenure. Families are paying the price for an anti-vaccine agenda being run out of the very department charged with protecting our health. I will keep building the case, alongside my Democratic colleagues, against the most corrupt and dangerous HHS Secretary our nation has ever seen. Come January, we will have the tools to get the answers Americans deserve.
**Thank You Maryland ** I want to sincerely thank Marylanders for the outpouring of love and support you have shown me and my family following the passing of my dear mother, Patricia Alsobrooks. It was so difficult to lose her, but our family will always feel the love she showed us. It shaped us. As painful as her loss has been for me, my sister Kim, my daughter Alex, and our whole family, we are heartened to know that she is reunited with my father, the love of her life, who passed away six months before my mom.
I'd like to share a lovely article about her in the [Banner](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenAlsobrooks&crop=15516.20653101.6482567.7190525&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fl.facebook.com%2fl.php%3fu%3dhttps%253A%252F%252Fwww.thebanner.com%252Fobituaries%252Fpatricia-pat-alsobrooks-obituary-prince-georges-county-BO3LLUFNKFAPJPPR7PBORS4CSI%253Ffbclid%253DIwZXh0bgNhZW0CMTAAcGRvZgVicmlkETE0b3dZWDdSM3psN1ZYdFFzc3J0YwZhcHBfaWQQMjIyMDM5MTc4ODIwMDg5MgABH8Y54odJlxTD4CHnKe0r0Fy_o4QzJl6TXTIeU1fFJchASoZVP0WC1r-t6RTi_aem_3_r0Y-jBynvKCI4gA_EzMA%26h%3dAUCLuZ9ZkcHLR8mlS0cydR5EBPq8wz5B9pnMtOyjd9unwJnPkHQXlk-veM1b7XOwS3waH2liCN3ao3ZAaKKFPgb9hYZmb1709K3O-lpEBc2dvq0ysBid3hzHafoSubC-KXbRKoIuiZRmZA%26__tn__%3d-UK-R%26c%5b0%5d%3dAUD6AdZFOfWA00Ued3TOVi9linPA0YafnffUix6mIthVaVQ5OA8hnGc7QKPuizAq8AM9hdB7l0A1vUVXtk3vkGreAuJrW_4vuhI8xT6ZFMtZVhORzfmdsdWfwuxJU4VwhIh61MlgoxYg8WbFksNavneJnAHRMk-6DN06vuLmdqvPGUyobetrX5sK8oCoknpPKY1YOU4wXl2Ej9HqvVLnB4ok87mf5A&redir_log=677750370334934). **Fighting Through Legislation **
It has been a busy few weeks here on Capitol Hill, and I continue to fight for legislation that will help Maryland families thrive. From helping veterans navigate the path to homeownership, to expanding access to women's health care and cancer screenings, to cutting red tape so seniors can get the care they need, I have worked on legislation that will make a real difference in the lives of Marylanders. These are the bills I have introduced: VA Home Loan Navigator Act: [This bipartisan legislation](https://outreach.senate.gov/iqextranet/iqClickTrk.aspx?&cid=SenAlsobrooks&crop=15516.20653101.6482567.7190525&report_id=&redirect=https%3a%2f%2fwww.facebook.com%2fphoto%3ffbid%3d122219246594758306%26set%3da.122093919404758306&redir_log=739577825833482) would establish a Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) program offering free, voluntary support to individuals eligible for VA home loan benefits. Designated organizations would help borrowers understand their benefits, navigate the mortgage process, resolve loan servicing issues, and explore options to avoid foreclosure. The bill would also establish training and conflict-of-interest requirements for participating organizations and require the VA to evaluate the program and report to Congress every two years. These are the bills I have cosponsored: Ecological Restoration Project Permitting Act of 2026: This legislation would establish a new permitting pathway under Section 404 of the Clean Water Act for projects that restore, enhance, or rehabilitate degraded aquatic habitats. This streamlined process could help farmers and conservation partners move conservation projects forward more efficiently, including restoring wetlands on marginal farmland, reconnecting floodplains, stabilizing eroding streambanks, and installing berms and water-control structures. S.5476: This bill would impose targeted sanctions on companies and other entities that facilitate, finance, or provide material support for the development of Israeli settlements in the E1 region of the West Bank. Affordability is Access Act of 2026: This legislation would increase access to birth control by requiring insurers to fully cover FDA-approved over-the-counter birth control with no out-of-pocket costs or prescription requirement. The bill would also prohibit any retailer that stocks contraception approved or regulated by the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) for routine, daily use without a prescription from interfering with a consumer's access to or purchase of that contraception. Jeanette Acosta Invest in Women's Health Act of 2026: This bill would increase women's access to preventive and lifesaving screenings for breast and gynecologic cancers, particularly for women with low incomes and women of color. The bill would authorize $20 million annually for fiscal years 2027 through 2029 for grants to public and nonprofit health care providers to expand preventive cancer services. It would also establish a demonstration program to train health care providers in breast and gynecologic cancer screening. Relief for Survivors of Miners Act: This bill would amend the Black Lung Benefits Act to ease the benefits process for survivors of miners who died of black lung disease. Title VIII Nursing Workforce Reauthorization Act: This bill would reauthorize the Title VIII Nursing Workforce Development Program through fiscal year 2030. The Title VIII programs aim to improve all aspects of nursing workforce development, including education, certification, recruitment, practice, and retention. Scientific Integrity Act: This bill would formalize and reinforce policies that require federal agencies that conduct or fund scientific research to maintain clear scientific integrity principles, affirm that scientific research should be free from political influence, and hold public scientists to high standards while guaranteeing their rights and protections under the law. Children Harmed in Life-Threatening or Dangerous (CHILD) Labor Act: This bill would strengthen penalties for violators of child labor laws. It would hold suppliers and subcontractors throughout the supply chain liable for child labor violations in the same manner as employers. It would also authorize the Secretary of Labor to label goods produced with child labor and issue stop-work orders to any violators of child labor provisions. Finally, it would require that federal contracts contain child labor provisions. Improving Seniors' Timely Access to Care Act of 2025: This legislation would modernize prior authorization in Medicare Advantage by requiring plans to establish an electronic prior authorization system beginning in 2028 and to meet new transparency requirements beginning in 2027. Safe Step Act: This bill would require employer-sponsored health plans that use medication step therapy to establish a clear and timely exceptions process. This process would allow patients to access a prescribed medication when required alternatives are ineffective, contraindicated, harmful, or could cause serious delays in treatment, or when a patient is already stable on the prescribed medication. United States Cadet Nurse Corps Service Recognition Act: This bill would recognize the service of former Cadet Nurses to our country and provide them with honorary veteran status, honorable discharges, a service medal, a burial plaque or grave marker, and other commendations. Investing in the American Dream Act: This bill would roll back changes made by the Trump Administration requiring a small business to be 100 percent owned by American citizens or nationals to be eligible for Small Business Administration (SBA) loans. The bill would restore and codify previous SBA policy, requiring small businesses to be located in the U.S. and at least 51 percent owned by citizens, nationals, and individuals lawfully in the country, including green card holders, asylees, and refugees, to be eligible for the SBA's 7(a), 504, Microloan, and Surety Bond programs. AVERT Future Violence Act of 2026: This legislation would commission a Department of Justice study to assess the link between acts of animal cruelty and future violence against others, such as domestic violence and gun violence. The bill would authorize a $2 million study and a $2 million grant program to provide personnel, training, technical assistance, data collection, and other resources. These resources would support mental health experts, law enforcement, and animal welfare organizations in the apprehension, prosecution, adjudication, and mental and behavioral health treatment of individuals who commit acts of animal cruelty. Puerto Rico Nutrition Assistance Fairness Act: This bill would transition Puerto Rico from the Nutrition Assistance Program (NAP) to the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP). New PACT for Iran Veterans Act: This legislation would require the VA to add Iran to the list of covered locations and take more proactive action to ensure that Iran War veterans, and all veterans who serve in future conflicts, don't have to jump through bureaucratic hoops to access the care they've earned through their service. Military Occupancy Living Defense (MOLD) Act: This bill would improve housing and environmental health and safety protections for members of the Armed Forces and their families living in military family housing. A resolution recognizing National Veterans Small Business Week. (Agreed to in the Senate) A resolution recognizing National 4-H Week. (Agreed to in the Senate) **In the Community **
I toured the University of Maryland Eastern Shore (UMES) School of Pharmacy and Health Professions and saw firsthand the incredible technology students use to prepare for careers in health care. I'll keep working to make sure every Marylander has the opportunity to succeed, no matter where they live.

Financial literacy is key to building a strong financial future. That's why I teamed up with FICO to bring a workshop to UMES on budgeting, saving, investing, and building credit, helping students make informed decisions about their money.

For generations, immigrants and refugees have helped strengthen our communities. For 33 years, Baltimore's Civil Rights Breakfast has brought people together to honor our progress and recommit to the work that lies ahead. Scientific Integrity Act: This bill would formalize and reinforce policies that require federal agencies that conduct or fund scientific research to maintain clear scientific integrity principles, affirm that scientific research should be free from political influence, and hold public scientists to high standards while guaranteeing their rights and protections under the law. Children Harmed in Life-Threatening or Dangerous (CHILD) Labor Act: This bill would strengthen penalties for violators of child labor laws. It would hold suppliers and subcontractors throughout the supply chain liable for child labor violations in the same manner as employers. It would also authorize the Secretary of Labor to label goods produced with child labor and issue stop-work orders to any violators of child labor provisions. Finally, it would require that federal contracts contain child labor provisions. Improving Seniors' Timely Access to Care Act of 2025: This legislation would modernize prior authorization in Medicare Advantage by requiring plans to establish an electronic prior authorization system beginning in 2028 and to meet new transparency requirements beginning in 2027. Safe Step Act: This bill would require employer-sponsored health plans that use medication step therapy to establish a clear and timely exceptions process. This process would allow patients to access a prescribed medication when required alternatives are ineffective, contraindicated, harmful, or could cause serious delays in treatment, or when a patient is already stable on the prescribed medication. United States Cadet Nurse Corps Service Recognition Act: This bill would recognize the service of former Cadet Nurses to our country and provide them with honorary veteran status, honorable discharges, a service medal, a burial plaque or grave marker, and other commendations. Investing in the American Dream Act: This bill would roll back changes made by the Trump Administration requiring a small business to be 100 percent owned by American citizens or nationals to be eligible for Small Business Administration (SBA) loans. The bill would restore and codify previous SBA policy, requiring small businesses to be located in the U.S. and at least 51 percent owned by citizens, nationals, and individuals lawfully in the country, including green card holders, asylees, and refugees, to be eligible for the SBA's 7(a), 504, Microloan, and Surety Bond programs. AVERT Future Violence Act of 2026: This legislation would commission a Department of Justice study to assess the link between acts of animal cruelty and future violence against others, such as domestic violence and gun violence. The bill would authorize a $2 million study and a $2 million grant program to provide personnel, training, technical assistance, data collection, and other resources. These resources would support mental health experts, law enforcement, and animal welfare organizations in the apprehension, prosecution, adjudication, and mental and behavioral health treatment of individuals who commit acts of animal cruelty. Puerto Rico Nutrition Assistance Fairness Act: This bill would transition Puerto Rico from the Nutrition Assistance Program (NAP) to the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP). New PACT for Iran Veterans Act: This legislation would require the VA to add Iran to the list of covered locations and take more proactive action to ensure that Iran War veterans, and all veterans who serve in future conflicts, don't have to jump through bureaucratic hoops to access the care they've earned through their service. Military Occupancy Living Defense (MOLD) Act: This bill would improve housing and environmental health and safety protections for members of the Armed Forces and their families living in military family housing. This city has a deep civil rights legacy, built by people who refused to let anyone else determine what was possible. Peter, we have exactly one week until our November end-of-month deadline. In a moment, we’re going to ask you to **[chip in $5, but first we want to explain why.](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp-ms-em-20261123-1.prQkVs&amount=5&refcode=em20261123-1370&t=1&akid=1370%2E34582%2Etx8l-s)**
A few weeks ago, voters handed Democrats one of the biggest election nights we’ve seen in decades. Democrats won in big cities and county seats nationwide.
This was Small Town PAC’s first election cycle, and we backed candidates from districts full of small towns and working class families. **Now, thanks to this team, five new Democrats are on their way to Congress and three new Democratic governors are getting ready to take office.**
But winning one cycle is just the start of the work. Small towns and rural areas deserve more than a visit every couple of years when someone needs their vote. Trust gets built in the off years, one conversation at a time.
That’s the reason Small Town PAC exists. We run on grassroots donations from everyday people, and to be ready for the elections ahead, we need that support in hand now.
**These next seven days matter. Staying on pace for our deadline means we can keep building with small towns and working families while most politicians have gone quiet.**

After November 3rd’s blue tsunami, I am ahead by less than 1% in Louisiana's 5th Congressional District— now I am headed to a runoff. The blue wave didn't flip Louisiana, a state Donald Trump won by 22 just two years ago. But against all odds it almost did. Our nominee, Democrat Jamie Davis, fell only 25k votes short of winning our US Senate seat, losing 49% to 50%. With no outside support , we fell short. But it's not too late to believe in Louisiana and pull off the unthinkable. In one of our reddest seats, LA-05, we lead by less than 1% and have forced a December 12 runoff where we can flip this seat. Clawing out this narrow lead took everything; our bank account now shows a 3 digit balance. And our GOP opponent has outraised us 20-1 with just mere weeks left to catch up. I'm now in the fight of my life. Derek,
**The DNC is taking a bold and unprecedented step to make sure YOUR voice is the loudest in the presidential nominating contest.**
[**And if you’re in a position to pitch in $7, your donation to elect Democrats has never been more powerful or important than right now.**](https://ak.democrats.org/go/2234?c0=em-dnc-november-2026-gfr.gb4rMu&refcode=em_20261123_10382_fr&amount=7&t=7&akid=10382%2E22930333%2Enxc5nf)

Here’s what we’re doing.
Anyone who wants to be on the Democratic presidential primary debate stage **_must**_ sign a pledge to denounce dark money and super PAC spending in our primary.
If they refuse or break their pledge, they will be barred from the debate stage. Simple as that.
Our historic midterm victories made one thing clear: The American people are sick and tired of a system that works for a wealthy few while the rest of us foot the bill.

I’m here to listen

[ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/143925975/661845263/1239926708?refcode=ea.59774c5b-5fe7-f111-91f3-000d3a533978&ms=ea.59774c5b-5fe7-f111-91f3-000d3a533978&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1OTc3NGM1Yi01ZmU3LWYxMTEtOTFmMy0wMDBkM2E1MzM5NzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=dYUCxFYEsLEGo4xJq8IwZ0HLP3UK1Z4jofob4p3MEN4=&emci=c0f9fff4-43e4-f111-91f3-000d3a533978&emdi=59774c5b-5fe7-f111-91f3-000d3a533978&ceid=51844520) Folks, it's Phil. If you know anything about former Governor Roy Romer, you know he's keen on listening to others — even when it may not be the easiest thing to do. In fact, that has been one of his most meaningful pieces of advice for me: _Don't be governed by yes-people. Be a leader who can take critical feedback._
_Credit for this photo goes to Allen West / Big Pivots. Credit for excellent advice goes to Gov. Romer._ **I'd like to ask for your advice as well — just reply to this email with any suggestions or guidance you have for me as I prepare to be sworn in. I'm looking forward to hearing what you have to say.** By his own admission, Gov. Romer broke all the rules when choosing someone to fill an appointed office, like the 400 judges he appointed in his 12 years as governor. Rather than treating it as a political appointment, he asked questions intended to help him get to know them on a deeper level and learn about their character — questions like, "What's the greatest crisis you've had in your life?" or "What pains you the most today?" I am grateful Gov. Romer was willing to share with me another key to success: working with people who were exceedingly talented, _and also_ who would be exceedingly honest at the same time. His wisdom and willingness to share have been truly irreplaceable as I've campaigned to be your next governor, and now as I prepare to take office. **Friend, I'd like to put Gov. Romer's advice into action right now by passing the microphone to you. Please reply to this message and let me know what kind of suggestions you'd offer — and I'll make sure to read every response.** With gratitude, Phil [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/143925977/661845265/-2014510844?refcode=ea.59774c5b-5fe7-f111-91f3-000d3a533978&ms=ea.59774c5b-5fe7-f111-91f3-000d3a533978&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1OTc3NGM1Yi01ZmU3LWYxMTEtOTFmMy0wMDBkM2E1MzM5NzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=dYUCxFYEsLEGo4xJq8IwZ0HLP3UK1Z4jofob4p3MEN4=&emci=c0f9fff4-43e4-f111-91f3-000d3a533978&emdi=59774c5b-5fe7-f111-91f3-000d3a533978&ceid=51844520)

| | The New York Times named my MediKids Act one of "8 Bold Ideas to Fix America." [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/143926918/661848652/-1994080617?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzk3MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzMGIyNTYzMS02MGU3LWYxMTEtOTFmMy0wMDBkM2E1MzM5NzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=AsbrMihTcLxdhRCHRXUSjdgTYxws7O0W6h8xdy-etmI=&emci=93659c07-5ce7-f111-91f3-000d3a533978&emdi=30b25631-60e7-f111-91f3-000d3a533978&ceid=26261389) The piece lays out what too many families already know. 4 million children in this country are uninsured. And with the Medicaid cuts passed by Republicans in their Big Disastrous Reconciliation Bill, another 3 million could lose coverage next year. Universal coverage for kids isn't a luxury, it's essential. **That's why I introduced MediKids.** Here's how it works:
* Every child born in America is automatically enrolled in Medicaid until age 26.
* Families can opt out if they prefer private insurance.
* No more coverage gaps from state to state.
* Higher standards of care, and lower administrative costs.

And it's designed to pass through reconciliation, which means we can get it done without Republicans blocking it. **This is not a pie-in-the-sky idea. It's bold, and it's implementable.** MediKids begins with kids and ends with guaranteeing healthcare for everyone in this country. Voters gave Democrats a strong mandate to fight for people and lower costs, and I'm going to keep pushing ideas like this one in the Senate. clean_body: The New York Times just spotlighted my MediKids Act. | | | | The New York Times named my MediKids Act one of "8 Bold Ideas to Fix America." The piece lays out what too many families already know. 4 million children in this country are uninsured. And with the Medicaid cuts passed by Republicans in their Big Disastrous Reconciliation Bill, another 3 million could lose coverage next year. Universal coverage for kids isn't a luxury, it's essential. That's why I introduced MediKids. Here's how it works: Every child born in America is automatically enrolled in Medicaid until age 26. Families can opt out if they prefer private insurance. No more coverage gaps from state to state. Higher standards of care, and lower administrative costs. And it's designed to pass through reconciliation, which means we can get it done without Republicans blocking it. This is not a pie-in-the-sky idea. It's bold, and it's implementable. MediKids begins with kids and ends with guaranteeing healthcare for everyone in this country. Voters gave Democrats a strong mandate to fight for people and lower costs, and I'm going to keep pushing ideas like this one in the Senate. name: Pramila Jayapal
subject: Trump officials are doubling down on deportations
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
They kill U.S. citizens in broad daylight.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20261123-6980-footer&t=1&akid=6980%2E420207%2Ek-zt0-)
Peter,
Despite an overwhelming victory for Democrats earlier this month — including enormous gains among immigrant communities who are furious with ICE agents terrorizing our communities — **Trump administration officials are doubling down on their immigration strategy:**
[](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/sign/em20261123-ice-petition/?source=em20261123-6980&t=2&akid=6980%2E420207%2Ek-zt0-)
While ICE insists that they’re deporting hardened criminals, Secretary of Homeland Security Markwayne Mullin has previously made it clear that their goal is to go after as many immigrants as possible – regardless of whether they have a criminal background.
**They’re terrorizing our communities, breaking down doors and kidnapping people without warrants, and tearing families apart in the middle of the night.**
They kill U.S. citizens in broad daylight. They snatch elderly people from their homes. And they send our community members to countries entirely unfamiliar to them, with no due process.
There are still families afraid to go to the grocery store for fear of being targeted by ICE. There are still children living in constant fear that their parents might not be there when they get home from school.
No one should have to live like this.
I want to be clear: ICE has never made our communities safer. They turn our neighborhoods into hunting grounds and weaponize fear against the most vulnerable communities — all to serve this administration’s cruel authoritarian agenda.
As the person in line to chair the committee that decides whether we treat immigrants with cruelty or humanity, I can promise you I’ll be bringing every one of the officials who kidnapped our neighbors, illegally detained and deported children, and killed people in our streets before Congress — and we are going to hold them accountable.
[**If you’re with me, add your name right now to demand an end to ICE’s cruelty.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/sign/em20261123-ice-petition/?source=em20261123-6980&t=3&akid=6980%2E420207%2Ek-zt0-)

In solidarity,
Pramila Jayapal

name: Voto Latino
subject: Latino voters showed up for these leaders. Now they need to show up for us.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Voto Latino
body:
Here’s what Voto Latino is calling on the next Congress to do.
#
Peter,
On November 3, Latino voters helped decide control of Congress. Now it’s our job to hold the people we elected accountable.
Here’s what Voto Latino is calling on the next Congress to do:
\- **Lower everyday costs** by cracking down on price gouging and junk fees, lowering utility bills, and raising the minimum wage.
\- **Lower health care costs** by extending ACA subsidies, expanding Medicare drug-price negotiation, and capping prescription costs.
\- **Build more affordable housing** and expand help for first-time homebuyers.
\- **Make child care affordable** and increase the number of providers.
\- **Help small businesses** start, grow, and hire.
\- **Connect workers to good jobs** through apprenticeships, community colleges, and job training.
\- **Create a path to citizenship** for Dreamers, TPS holders, and long-term residents, and **hold ICE and Border Patrol accountable for abuses.**
\- **Protect our elections** and make voting accessible for every eligible voter.
\- **Make government programs easier to use** for the families who rely on them.
Latino voters showed up for these leaders, and **now they need to show up for us.**
Voto Latino will be watching every vote, every bill, and every promise, and we’ll make sure our community knows who delivered and who didn’t.
**[Will you chip in $3 or any amount to help Voto Latino mobilize our community and keep up the pressure to make sure the next Congress delivers for Latino families?](https://act.votolatino.org/go/57?c0=em-ms-voto-20261123-1.1a53dg&amount=3&refcode=em20261123-800&t=1&akid=800%2E1366028%2Eph_lz0)**

Thank you,
Voto Latino

_How do you investigate a president this corrupt?_
That’s the title of Ezra Klein’s recent podcast episode, in which he interviewed me about my plans for holding the Trump Administration accountable as Chair of the House Oversight Committee.
**My answer is clear: cut through the blizzard of corruption, follow the money that hurts working families, and pass tough new laws so no president can ever pull this off again.**
**[Can I count on you to rush a donation to help me continue this work?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/143929130/661857008/-309737922?refcode=261123_RG_ezraklein&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTcxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5NmY3NThhZi02NmU3LWYxMTEtOTFmMy0wMDBkM2E1MzM5NzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=V7HpN2Z3SQrZtQKhL5bjhCezx1i5QmAUfeded7reg-c=)**[DONATE NOW](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/143929133/661857011/-309737922?refcode=261123_RG_ezraklein&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTcxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5NmY3NThhZi02NmU3LWYxMTEtOTFmMy0wMDBkM2E1MzM5NzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=V7HpN2Z3SQrZtQKhL5bjhCezx1i5QmAUfeded7reg-c=)
Right now, people are working harder than ever just to cover gas and groceries, while the president’s family and inner circle reportedly treat the federal government like a private ATM:
* Lucrative Pentagon contracts
* Billions in foreign deals
* An opaque crypto slush fund
* Pay-to-play contract schemes at DHS
* A massive White House ballroom

As Ezra put it when we talked about companies backed by the president’s sons suddenly landing lucrative Pentagon contracts: that pattern feels both very consistent and very corrupt. And my response was simple: it feels corrupt because it likely is.
Look, Donald Trump and his allies aren’t going to hand over documents or testify under oath out of the goodness of their hearts. They are already threatening legal reprisals, installing loyalists at the Justice Department to run interference, and preparing to stonewall us at every turn.
**_That is why winning the House majority changes everything._**
Starting in January, we won’t have to ask nicely. With the Oversight gavel, we have real power—and the authority to go straight to the federal courts to enforce accountability when the administration tries to bury the truth.
Taking on billionaires, corporate insiders, and an entrenched administration takes a massive grassroots movement behind us before Day One even begins.

body:
# [](https://act.janepac.com/go/30?t=1&akid=44%2E6803%2EW577WY)
[](https://act.janepac.com/go/38?c0=ms_jfcp_em_20261110_exit_survey.t1qSld&source=em20261123-44&t=3&akid=44%2E6803%2EW577WY)
Did you see Jane’s message?
Now that we’ve had a few weeks to take it all in, we’re ready to roll up our sleeves and start planning for the next wave of climate leaders we’re going to elect – and how we’re going to keep the pressure on the ones we’ve sent to power!
But as we prepare to take on Big Oil and Big Tech in 2027, we want to make sure we hear directly from you, one of the people who made these wins even possible in the first place.
**So tell us: How are you feeling after the midterm elections? What’s top of mind for you as we look ahead?[Take our quick survey and let us know: ](https://act.janepac.com/go/38?c0=ms_jfcp_em_20261110_exit_survey.t1qSld&source=em20261123-44&t=4&akid=44%2E6803%2EW577WY)**
**[Take the survey ››](https://act.janepac.com/go/38?c0=ms_jfcp_em_20261110_exit_survey.t1qSld&source=em20261123-44&t=5&akid=44%2E6803%2EW577WY)**
Thank you for being in this fight with us,
Team JanePAC
_\---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Jane Fonda
Date: Saturday, Nov 14, 2026 at 9:30 AM
Subject: Our next move starts with you
_
I want to take a second to check in with the heart of our movement: **you.**
**We helped elect over 216 courageous climate champions to offices all across the country!** Michigan. Texas. My home state of California. Pennsylvania. Georgia. The list goes on.
These fearless leaders took on corporate polluters, shady dark money groups, and even a trillionaire named Elon Musk with millions to spend. But they didn’t back down. Not for a second.
And on Election Day, we saw victories in places where change once seemed impossible. I’ll never forget that feeling.
You helped make a better future possible, and as we look toward the next chapter of our movement, I want to hear directly from you about where we go next:
_How are you feeling after Election Day’s results?_
_What message resonated with you the most?_
_What moment made you feel that hope was truly possible?_
**[Please take two minutes to share your thoughts. I’m personally reading your responses as we chart our path forward.](https://act.janepac.com/go/38?c0=ms_jfcp_em_20261110_exit_survey.t1qSld&source=em20261123-44&t=6&akid=44%2E6803%2EW577WY)**
**[Take the survey ››](https://act.janepac.com/go/38?c0=ms_jfcp_em_20261110_exit_survey.t1qSld&source=em20261123-44&t=7&akid=44%2E6803%2EW577WY)**
Checking in and showing up for one another is how people power grows. We cannot afford to take a single step back now.
**My team and I are making critical decisions for the fight ahead. We’re taking a hard look at what worked, what needs to shift, and how JanePAC can rise to meet this political moment with the moral courage it demands.**
But we can’t do that without the people who built this foundation.
**[Will you take two minutes to share your Election Day reflections?](https://act.janepac.com/go/38?c0=ms_jfcp_em_20261110_exit_survey.t1qSld&source=em20261123-44&t=8&akid=44%2E6803%2EW577WY)**
**[Take the survey ››](https://act.janepac.com/go/38?c0=ms_jfcp_em_20261110_exit_survey.t1qSld&source=em20261123-44&t=9&akid=44%2E6803%2EW577WY)**
**This work has never been about a single voice. It’s a chorus. And your voice belongs in it.**
Thanks for being here.
xx Jane

# [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/143930505/661861443/439559405?refcode=em-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDg3ODciLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYzRiMmFjMGQtNjhlNy1mMTExLTkxZjMtMDAwZDNhNTMzOTc4IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=T0O_0R5yEapOuWO-_t38MaUm5LoJlP2xRvjw6a07YVc=)
Friend, Two years ago, I was a pharmacist and Army veteran running for Congress for the first time, in one of the closest House races in the country. Now that the votes have been counted, I wanted to walk you through what stood out to me from this election:
* **The margin.** We went from 653 votes in 2024 to 61% of the vote this year.

* **The coalition.** We earned endorsements from law enforcement and firefighters, from business and labor, and from the LA Times.

* **The groundwork.** Our volunteers knocked on over 30,000 doors from Westminster to Cerritos to Fullerton.

Voters also had two years of my work to judge. When the GKN plant emergency forced Garden Grove families out of their homes, I fought for our first responders and for small business disaster loans. And, despite House Dems then being in the minority, I spearheaded a bipartisan bill into law that protects small businesses from foreign interference in federal research programs. In January, I’ll be serving in the majority for the first time, and I’ll keep bringing back results for CA-45. That is how we keep this hardwon seat blue. Thank you again for defending this district,

Brad Finstad has called for a recount, and we’re confident that I will be confirmed as the new Congressman in southern Minnesota. This past weekend, we celebrated North Carolina’s birthday marking the day it became the 12th state to join the Union, and the hardworking people and strong communities that make our state such a special place to call home. This year, we have another reason to celebrate. I am thrilled to congratulate the newly-elected members of our delegation who earned the trust and support of voters all across the state and won their elections earlier this month. I look forward to working alongside this dedicated group of leaders as we take on the challenges facing our state and work to deliver meaningful results for the people we represent. There is plenty of work ahead of us. From lowering the cost of living and creating greater economic opportunities to rooting out corruption and making government work better for the people it serves, I am excited about what we can accomplish together. Above all, I'm grateful for the opportunity to serve the people of North Carolina and proud to work alongside such an incredible group of representatives. From our state's history to the promise of its future, I look forward to the work ahead to make North Carolina an even better place for generations to come. Let's get to work! Valerie Foushee

# [Jensen Huang RETURNS as Nvidia CEO, stock rockets 33%](https://substack.com/redirect/3292ce88-3515-46d3-be32-21ecd040c583?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Nvidia's board **[voted unanimously Monday](https://substack.com/redirect/ee7f5961-3fd7-48fb-8ea2-fb04e0eb8080?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** to **[restore Jensen Huang as CEO and president effective immediately,](https://substack.com/redirect/5fa463ab-c9e1-4a92-8537-b04d9aa19050?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** 11 days after his Nov. 12 resignation over extramarital affairs. Shares[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/397d480d-1db8-465f-8cac-e7765cf11ed3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[jumped nearly 30%](https://substack.com/redirect/397d480d-1db8-465f-8cac-e7765cf11ed3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** as **[Trump backed the move](https://substack.com/redirect/14ee66c3-38d5-4371-8092-12249fce2c7f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and the board cited senior U.S. government input that he poses no national security risk.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/3292ce88-3515-46d3-be32-21ecd040c583?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Unanimous board vote** : Directors said discussions satisfied them on Huang's candor and ability to lead; independent probe into foreign-intelligence reports continues.
* **Trump full endorsement** : President called the decision "correct and proper," stated the U.S. sees no unlawful conduct, and said the country needs Huang's leadership.
* **Market value jump** : Stock opened around $160 after Friday's close near $125.53, adding hundreds of billions in value in early trading.
* **Probe still active** : Board created a National Security and Export Control Committee; Colette Kress remains CFO after serving as interim CEO.

# [Nasdaq rockets 7% as Huang returns to Nvidia](https://substack.com/redirect/3292ce88-3515-46d3-be32-21ecd040c583?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Major[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/07114095-9d6b-4fd3-907b-9c5ab02253fc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[indexes roared higher Monday](https://substack.com/redirect/07114095-9d6b-4fd3-907b-9c5ab02253fc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** after Nvidia reinstated Huang, with the Nasdaq climbing nearly[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/ec8a633d-e897-4ec7-aa3a-d6ced71f408f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[7%](https://substack.com/redirect/ec8a633d-e897-4ec7-aa3a-d6ced71f408f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** , the S&P 500 adding about **[4.8%](https://substack.com/redirect/ec8a633d-e897-4ec7-aa3a-d6ced71f408f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** , and the Dow rising more than[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/ec8a633d-e897-4ec7-aa3a-d6ced71f408f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[1,200 points.](https://substack.com/redirect/ec8a633d-e897-4ec7-aa3a-d6ced71f408f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** The move followed **[last week's record point drops](https://substack.com/redirect/fe8d0347-f0e2-4347-b734-b4d4922fca6b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** that pushed the S&P into correction territory.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/3292ce88-3515-46d3-be32-21ecd040c583?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**Index gains locked** : Nasdaq 100 futures briefly hit circuit-breaker limits; chip stocks including AMD and Broadcom rallied alongside Nvidia.
**Prior week damage** : Indexes notched their biggest one-week point declines on record, according to Dow Jones Market Data, after a seven-day S&P losing streak.
**Futures lead** : Premarket contracts for the Nasdaq were up more than 3% before the open as buyers tested the waters.
**Oversold bounce** : Strategists noted the move came after extreme selling, with some calling it mechanical after the prior week's liquidation.

# [Trump cheer Huang back at Nvidia, "Sex sells"](https://substack.com/redirect/3292ce88-3515-46d3-be32-21ecd040c583?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Nvidia's board reinstated Huang roughly 11 hours **[after Trump publicly urged the move,](https://substack.com/redirect/dbb3f4bc-0008-4413-8aa8-4d16dd71a269?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** with the stock rising as much as 30% premarket and Nasdaq futures halted limit-up. Goldman's Privorotsky asked whether the **["Trump put" had returned](https://substack.com/redirect/49d579cb-0b4a-494e-89fe-6171ebf21552?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and whether to sell the squeeze.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/3292ce88-3515-46d3-be32-21ecd040c583?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Timing of vote** : Board cited senior government input that left it confident Huang posed no national-security risk.

# [ARM CEO Haas rebuffs Nvidia, extends Arm contract to 2033](https://substack.com/redirect/3292ce88-3515-46d3-be32-21ecd040c583?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Arm CEO Rene Haas, **[a leading external candidate for the Nvidia job, extended his contract through 2033](https://substack.com/redirect/a7f44679-e67a-49f4-97cf-c389fad4c871?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and will become SoftBank vice chairman starting Dec. 1. The move ends speculation he might succeed Huang **[after the board approached him following the resignation.](https://substack.com/redirect/b5537a9f-c3cb-48d8-b9d6-f64454427014?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/3292ce88-3515-46d3-be32-21ecd040c583?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Prior Nvidia role** : Haas spent roughly seven years at Nvidia before joining Arm in 2013 and becoming CEO in 2022.
* **SoftBank role** : He assumes the vice-chairman position at Arm's majority owner effective Dec. 1.
* **Statement** : Haas said he has "never been more confident about Arm's future" and is committed to realizing its potential for years.
* **Search context** : Nvidia's board had hired a search firm; other names floated included Lisa Su and Tim Cook before Huang's return.

# [Don't trust it: Rosenberg calls rebound a "dead cat bounce"](https://substack.com/redirect/3292ce88-3515-46d3-be32-21ecd040c583?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
David Rosenberg labeled Monday's futures rally a **["classic dead-cat bounce"](https://substack.com/redirect/051af78c-f0cd-4c8f-a395-676af0389112?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** after last week's "epic drubbing," noting equities are oversold but the move may not be trustworthy. He pointed to thinned holiday-week volumes that amplified the volatility.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/3292ce88-3515-46d3-be32-21ecd040c583?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Technical damage** : Rosenberg said much damage remains despite the oversold condition.
* **Volume effect** : A holiday-shortened week thinned trading and exaggerated swings.
* **Caution on trust** : He evoked a film line about never trusting certain things, applying it to the bounce.
* **Context of drop** : The prior week delivered the S&P's largest one-week point decline on record.

# [Rare flip: Growth stocks cheaper than value since 2008](https://substack.com/redirect/3292ce88-3515-46d3-be32-21ecd040c583?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
The iShares S&P 500 Growth ETF closed Friday at 16.4 times forward earnings, below the value ETF's 16.6,[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/41af1f39-92fa-42e9-a29e-d714c33d19fe?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[the first such discount since the 2008-2009 financial crisis.](https://substack.com/redirect/41af1f39-92fa-42e9-a29e-d714c33d19fe?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** The inversion arrived after the sharp tech and AI selloff.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/3292ce88-3515-46d3-be32-21ecd040c583?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Valuation flip** : Growth now sits at a slight discount to value on a forward-earnings basis.
* **Historical rarity** : The last time growth was cheaper than value was during the financial crisis.
* **Selloff driver** : The shift followed last week's heavy declines in AI and technology names.
* **Context for bounce** : The relative cheapness appeared just as markets began rebounding on the Huang news.

# [Nightmare week ends: Futures surge on Huang hopes](https://substack.com/redirect/3292ce88-3515-46d3-be32-21ecd040c583?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
**[Nasdaq futures jumped](https://substack.com/redirect/717227b1-26ab-48aa-a4e2-467d7a161540?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and Nvidia shares surged more than 30% premarket after the board said Huang would return immediately, putting the stock on track to recoup losses since Nov. 13. The move **[followed a week that delivered the indexes' largest point drops on record.](https://substack.com/redirect/fe8d0347-f0e2-4347-b734-b4d4922fca6b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/3292ce88-3515-46d3-be32-21ecd040c583?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Premarket surge** : Nvidia was up more than 27% before the open as buyers stepped in.
* **Index contracts** : Nasdaq futures led the recovery after the prior week's AI-driven liquidation.
* **Recoup path** : The stock was positioned to reverse declines that began after the Nov. 12 resignation.
* **Worst week** : All three major indexes recorded their biggest one-week point declines, per Dow Jones data.

# [$43.9B all-stock: CrowdStrike acquires Zscaler](https://substack.com/redirect/3292ce88-3515-46d3-be32-21ecd040c583?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
CrowdStrike **[agreed Monday to buy Zscaler](https://substack.com/redirect/d51e0dcb-3919-4050-a9f7-2b2f7ab02b91?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** in a[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/8d0b8b37-6097-4981-938e-d368ef849a2e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[$43.9 billion all-stock](https://substack.com/redirect/8d0b8b37-6097-4981-938e-d368ef849a2e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/8d0b8b37-6097-4981-938e-d368ef849a2e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)transaction, **[the largest cybersecurity deal on record,](https://substack.com/redirect/a48b91f4-fe32-4529-8ecf-36aabe0bfa82?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** uniting endpoint and zero-trust network security as AI-driven threats rise. Zscaler shareholders receive 1.135 CrowdStrike shares, a roughly 34% premium, with the deal expected to close in the second half of CrowdStrike's fiscal 2028.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/3292ce88-3515-46d3-be32-21ecd040c583?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Premium and ownership** : Implied value of about $260.41 per Zscaler share; CrowdStrike holders will own roughly 84% of the combined company.
* **Revenue scale** : Combined firm is expected to start with more than $10 billion in annual recurring revenue, including about $3.9 billion from Zscaler.
* **Leadership plan** : George Kurtz remains CEO of the combined company; Jay Chaudhry will run the Zscaler business and join CrowdStrike's board.
* **Market reaction** : Zscaler shares jumped in premarket trading while CrowdStrike fell on dilution concerns; companies operate separately until close.
